zh: 接触链：从种子节点按一跳、两跳逐步扩展得到的联系人集合。
共同邻居：同时与 a、b 相连的节点集合大小。
Jaccard：共同邻居占并集的比例，消除节点度的影响。
Adamic-Adar：按共同邻居的度加权，降低高 degree 枢纽的权重。
en: Contact chain: the set of contacts reached from a seed by one hop, two hops and so on.
Common neighbors: the number of nodes linked to both a and b.
Jaccard: common neighbors divided by the union, reducing degree effects.
Adamic-Adar: weights common neighbors by inverse log degree, downweighting hubs.

zh.principle: **攻击**：接触分析（Contact Analysis）。接触分析（contact analysis / contact chaining）把通信元数据建成图：节点是电话号码、账号、设备或身份标识，边是通话、短信、邮件等接触事件，边权可以是次数、时长或时间窗。从已知目标 s 出发，一跳邻居 Γ(s) 是直接接触者，k 跳集合 C_k(s)={v | d_G(s,v)≤k} 是扩展接触链。候选关联可用共同邻居与相似度排序：CN(a,b)=|Γ(a)∩Γ(b)|；Jaccard J(a,b)=|Γ(a)∩Γ(b)|/|Γ(a)∪Γ(b)|；Adamic-Adar AA(a,b)=Σ_{z∈Γ(a)∩Γ(b)}1/log deg(z)。这些分数不是罪证，只是把“谁与谁可能相识”变成可排序的假设。评估用阈值 τ：score≥τ 判为正候选，再以 precision=TP/(TP+FP)、recall=TP/(TP+FN) 权衡。k 增大覆盖更广，但 |C_k| 和误报也会上升；所以调查设计同时受 hop 数、时间窗、节点类型和复核能力约束。
zh.why: 接触链能把分散的通信记录变成网络结构，帮助找到直接联系人、共同联系人、桥梁节点和孤立子网。它对反恐、反欺诈、执法和事件响应有价值，但也是隐私争议核心：元数据虽不含内容，仍能推断关系、位置、作息和社交圈。关键区别：contact chaining 产生的是“可疑关联”，不是“有罪关联”。必须把发现、复核、清除和审计分开，避免把图上的边当成事实。
zh.used: 步骤：1）定义节点、边与时间窗；2）从种子号码做 1..k 跳扩展；3）计算共同邻居、Jaccard、Adamic-Adar；4）按 τ 排序候选；5）人工复核共享号码、NAT、客服/总机、二次验证号；6）记录 precision/recall 与删除策略。对抗性场景要限制查询范围、留存期和结果使用；对高 degree 枢纽（客服、VoIP 网关、短信号）要单独处理，否则两跳会因枢纽把大量无关用户连在一起。
zh.broken: 失效：元数据错误、号码复用、共享手机、NAT/运营商代理、一次性号码；加密只隐藏内容，不隐藏元数据；k 跳扩展会指数级放大误报；ground truth 缺失使 precision/recall 不可信；法律授权与留存边界可能让结果不可用。
zh.history:
SIGINT 的 contact chaining 在 20 世纪中后期成熟；2013 年斯诺登披露 NSA 国内电话元数据项目后，三跳/两跳、五年/十八个月留存成为公共争论。2015 年美国国家科学院报告把 contact chaining 作为技术选项之一；2016 年开源论文提出可审计的接触链协议；电话元数据研究显示高 degree 枢纽会让“两跳”覆盖远超直觉。

en.principle: **Attack**: Contact Analysis (接触分析). Contact analysis, or contact chaining, turns communication metadata into a graph. Nodes are phone numbers, accounts, devices or identifiers; edges are calls, texts, emails or other contact events; edge weights can be counts, duration or a time window. Starting from a target s, the one-hop neighbors Γ(s) are direct contacts, and the k-hop set C_k(s)={v | d_G(s,v)≤k} is the extended contact chain. Candidate associations can be ranked with common neighbors and similarity scores: CN(a,b)=|Γ(a)∩Γ(b)|; Jaccard J(a,b)=|Γ(a)∩Γ(b)|/|Γ(a)∪Γ(b)|; Adamic-Adar AA(a,b)=Σ_{z∈Γ(a)∩Γ(b)}1/log deg(z). These scores are not proof of guilt; they turn “who may know whom” into rankable hypotheses. Evaluation uses a threshold τ: score≥τ marks a positive candidate, then precision=TP/(TP+FP) and recall=TP/(TP+FN) trade off. Larger k broadens coverage, but |C_k| and false positives grow. Investigation design is therefore constrained by hop count, time window, node type and review capacity.
en.why:
Contact chains turn scattered records into network structure and help find direct contacts, shared contacts, bridge nodes and isolated subnetworks. They matter for counterterrorism, fraud, law enforcement and incident response, but they are also a privacy fault line: metadata has no content, yet it can reveal relationships, location, routines and social circles.

The key distinction: contact chaining produces “suspicion by association”, not guilt by association. Discovery, review, deletion and audit must remain separate so that graph edges are not treated as facts.
en.used:
Steps: 1) define nodes, edges and a time window; 2) expand 1..k hops from the seed; 3) compute common neighbors, Jaccard and Adamic-Adar; 4) rank candidates by τ; 5) review shared numbers, NAT, support lines, switchboards and two-factor numbers; 6) record precision/recall and a deletion policy.

In adversarial settings, limit query scope, retention and use of results. Treat high-degree hubs such as support lines, VoIP gateways and SMS gateways separately; otherwise two hops will connect many unrelated users through a hub.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken: Failure modes: metadata errors, number reuse, shared phones, NAT/carrier proxies, disposable numbers; encryption hides content, not metadata; k-hop expansion multiplies false positives; missing ground truth makes precision/recall unreliable; legal authorization and retention limits may make results unusable.
en.history: SIGINT contact chaining matured in the mid-to-late 20th century. After the 2013 Snowden disclosures of the NSA domestic telephone metadata program, three hops versus two hops and five years versus eighteen months became public disputes. A 2015 National Academies report treated contact chaining as one technical option; a 2016 open paper proposed auditable contact-chaining protocols; telephone-metadata research showed that high-degree hubs make “two hops” reach far beyond intuition.
